text.title: RAG Policy Thresholds Output Contract
text.summary: Draft-07 JSON Schema for `RAGPolicy`: per-signal numeric `amber_threshold` / `red_threshold` with a comparator and unit, an `input_source` that names a system and a repeatable query, at least one incident / post-mortem / policy / baseline anchor per signal, an Amber step with a deadline inside the reporting cycle, a Red playbook with an hour bound, a `review_log` of reviews and overrides (a computed Red is never reported lower), and a `colour_history` of computed cycles that cite the policy version. Validator: `scripts/validate-rag-policy-thresholds.py`; staleness: `scripts/staleness-check.py`.

section.title: JSON Schema (draft-07)
section.note: What the validator's cross-field block checks beyond the schema: `red_threshold` lies strictly beyond `amber_threshold` in the comparator's direction, and for `eq` the two differ (r-red-strictly-beyond-amber); `amber.deadline_hours` is at most `reporting_cadence_days` x 24 (r-red-action-named-and-time-bound); every `colour_history` entry's `values` cover every signal, its `computed_colour` equals the worst per-signal colour obtained by applying the comparator to the thresholds, with no averaging (r-worst-signal-wins); a `reported_colour` that differs from `computed_colour` has an `override` entry in `review_log` for that `cycle_date` (r-override-logged-never-downgrades-red); `computed_at` is at most 90 days after `policy_last_reviewed` (r-review-within-90-days-prunes-and-adds). Whether `header.last_reviewed` is stale today is time-relative and is checked by `scripts/staleness-check.py`.

example.code: { "project_id": "checkout", "header": { "owner": {"role": "pm", "person": "olena.k"}, "version": "1.4.0", "last_reviewed": "2026-05-10", "reporting_cadence_days": 7 }, "signals": [ { "signal_id": "schedule_variance_pct", "unit": "percent", "input_source": {"system": "Jira", "query": "dashboard 'Checkout EV' panel 'SV%' = (EV - PV) / PV * 100"}, "comparator": "gt", "amber_threshold": 10, "red_threshold": 20, "evidence": ["incident-2025-Q4-acme-overrun", "policy://pmo/schedule-tolerance"] }, { "signal_id": "budget_variance_pct", "unit": "percent", "input_source": {"system": "NetSuite", "query": "saved export 'checkout-cost-vs-plan' column CV%"}, "comparator": "gt", "amber_threshold": 5, "red_threshold": 15, "evidence": ["policy://pmo/budget-tolerance"] }, { "signal_id": "defect_escape_rate", "unit": "ratio", "input_source": {"system": "Sentry", "query": "saved search 'checkout prod new issues / releases' weekly"}, "comparator": "gt", "amber_threshold": 0.05, "red_threshold": 0.1, "evidence": ["postmortem-2026-Q1-checkout-hotfix"] }, { "signal_id": "blockers_open_count", "unit": "count", "input_source": {"system": "Jira", "query": "project = CHK AND flagged = Impediment AND status != Done"}, "comparator": "gte", "amber_threshold": 2, "red_threshold": 4, "evidence": ["baseline-chk-2026-q1-blockers"] } ], "actions": { "green": "continue the weekly cadence; record value, version and last_reviewed", "amber": {"step": "PM runs a mid-week health check with the tech lead and posts findings in the status thread", "deadline_hours": 72}, "red": {"playbook": "distressed-project-rescue", "first_step": "sponsor notified and rescue playbook opened", "within_hours": 4, "fires_at": "compute_time"} }, "review_log": [ { "logged_at": "2026-05-10", "kind": "review", "person": "olena.k", "version_after": "1.4.0", "signals_removed": [{"signal_id": "pr_review_latency_hours", "reason": "no Amber or Red in Q4 2025 and Q1 2026"}], "signals_justified": [{"signal_id": "budget_variance_pct", "reason": "no Amber in two periods but it is the sponsor's contractual tolerance"}], "signals_added_or_tightened": [{"signal_id": "defect_escape_rate", "reason": "Q1 hotfix incident was not flagged ahead; amber tightened from 0.08 to 0.05", "evidence": ["postmortem-2026-Q1-checkout-hotfix"]}] }, { "logged_at": "2026-05-18", "kind": "override", "person": "olena.k", "cycle_date": "2026-05-18", "computed_colour": "amber", "reported_colour": "green", "reason": "Jira EV panel double-counted the sprint 14 carry-over; corrected SV% is 6" } ], "colour_history": [ { "computed_at": "2026-05-18", "policy_version": "1.4.0", "policy_last_reviewed": "2026-05-10", "values": [ {"signal_id": "schedule_variance_pct", "value": 12}, {"signal_id": "budget_variance_pct", "value": 3}, {"signal_id": "defect_escape_rate", "value": 0.02}, {"signal_id": "blockers_open_count", "value": 1} ], "computed_colour": "amber", "reported_colour": "green" }, { "computed_at": "2026-05-25", "policy_version": "1.4.0", "policy_last_reviewed": "2026-05-10", "values": [ {"signal_id": "schedule_variance_pct", "value": 22}, {"signal_id": "budget_variance_pct", "value": 4}, {"signal_id": "defect_escape_rate", "value": 0.03}, {"signal_id": "blockers_open_count", "value": 1} ], "computed_colour": "red", "reported_colour": "red", "red_escalated_at": "2026-05-25T10:40" } ] }

example.note: Subject violations: `amber_threshold: "significant"` is prose, not a number (r-threshold-numeric-with-comparator); `test_coverage_pct` is a `lt` signal whose red (70) lies above amber (60), so the Amber band is empty (r-red-strictly-beyond-amber); `input_source.query` is a PM estimate (r-input-source-is-a-query); evidence `TBD` (r-evidence-anchor-per-signal); Amber action "discuss" and a Red action that fires at the next sync (r-red-action-named-and-time-bound); an override that reports a computed Red as Amber, and a cycle whose `computed_colour` is Amber while `schedule_variance_pct` = 22 is over the Red threshold of 20 (r-override-logged-never-downgrades-red, r-worst-signal-wins).

antipattern.description: `amber_threshold` or `red_threshold` that is not a number, a missing comparator, or a unit that differs from what the query returns.
antipattern.reason: r-threshold-numeric-with-comparator: "significant slippage" is renegotiated every week under stakeholder pressure.

antipattern.description: `red_threshold` not strictly beyond `amber_threshold` in the comparator's direction, or equal thresholds on an `eq` signal.
antipattern.reason: r-red-strictly-beyond-amber: the project jumps from Green to Red with no warning window.

antipattern.description: `input_source.query` reading "estimate", "gut feel", "consensus" or "ask the lead", or a schedule / budget signal that is not a percent variance against plan.
antipattern.reason: r-input-source-is-a-query: a threshold is only reproducible if the input is.

antipattern.description: A `colour_history` entry whose `computed_colour` is better than the worst per-signal colour, or values missing for a signal.
antipattern.reason: r-worst-signal-wins: averaging is how a 25% overrun reports Green.

antipattern.description: `reported_colour` differing from `computed_colour` with no `override` entry for that cycle, or an override whose `computed_colour` is red and `reported_colour` is not.
antipattern.reason: r-override-logged-never-downgrades-red: if the override path is free, the policy is decoration.

antipattern.description: `evidence` empty, or a value such as `TBD`, `see ticket` or `experience` instead of an `incident-`, `postmortem-`, `policy://` or `baseline-` anchor; a tightened threshold with no new anchor.
antipattern.reason: r-evidence-anchor-per-signal: a threshold nobody can trace is a threshold nobody will defend.

antipattern.description: `actions.red` without a playbook or an hour bound, `fires_at` other than `compute_time`, an Amber step reading "discuss" or "monitor", or a deadline outside the reporting cycle.
antipattern.reason: r-red-action-named-and-time-bound: teams that reach Red and "discuss it Monday" reach Red for six consecutive weeks.

antipattern.description: A cycle computed more than 90 days after `policy_last_reviewed`, a review entry without removed / justified / added lists, or a cycle that does not cite `policy_version`.
antipattern.reason: r-review-within-90-days-prunes-and-adds: thresholds set once become folklore.

text.reference: Stdlib-only validator for this contract; `--self-test` runs both examples above.
Flags a policy whose `header.last_reviewed` is older than 90 days.
Markdown skeleton with the same signal columns, action fields and log sections.
